_doc: Plugin edition defaults, layered on top of workflow/config.json only when this code runs as the MemoryAtoms plugin (lib/edition.layered_config). The installed (git) edition never reads this file. Anything here can be overridden in <data folder>/workflow/config.json or config.local.json.

guard_family._doc: The coding-guard family (commit-order gate, cross-layer gates, verification ledger and batch gate, privacy commit gate, smell gate, OverviewHub, chain breaker, ask gate, code reconcile, red-test, equivalence, deferral, closing checklist, sync reminder, deep post-mortem, DocDrift) does not ship with the plugin: enabled=false skips every one of those checks and does not load their modules. Memory itself (per-prompt injection, write gates that point to atom_write, harvest, usefulness attribution, cards re-sent after compaction) runs as usual (hooks/wg_core.guard_family_on).

vcs_sync._doc: No background git commit / push / pull of the memory folders (root, project, and organization layers). Your cards stay on this machine until you turn sync on yourself.

merge_driver._doc: Never edits your global git config (~/.gitconfig) to install the index merge driver automatically.

skill_index._doc: No background regeneration of the skill index after a SKILL.md changes (it would write into the plugin folder).

eol._doc: Does not add a block to your project's .gitattributes or set svn:eol-style on your project files after a card is written.
